title: Objective-based RRT: first star
description: Objective-based RRT from power-on to King Bob-omb's star ("Big Bob-omb on the Summit"). Two chained runs: v5 climbed to the summit in 8 minutes of search, then king2 grabbed and threw the King three times in 6 minutes. 6,100 frames.

regions.label: Menus and intro
regions.note: Fixed boot inputs, then waiting for Mario to be still and controllable.

regions.label: Run v5: castle to the summit
regions.note: Objective pool (PosDist, Painting::Enter, coins, doors…) grows the tree into BoB and up the mountain.

regions.label: Run king2: King Bob-omb
regions.note: Boss::Hit from behind: grab with B, throw; three hits, then Star::Collect.
